overview: The client-settings packet carries locale, view distance, chat visibility and the skin-parts bitmask, so anticheats read it for two purposes: enforcing protocol limits (Grim CrashE, BetterAnticheat SmallRender) and tying chat visibility to chat activity (Grim ChatD, BetterAnticheat HiddenChat). Photon reads the skin bitmask to catch skinblinker mods that toggle parts while sprinting or that set the unused 0x80 bit.

checks.name: ChatD hidden chat (Grim)
checks.purpose: Stop chat messages from clients that set chat visibility to hidden.
checks.how_it_works: Tracks the chatVisibility flag from CLIENT_SETTINGS in both the play and configuration protocol states, then cancels any CHAT_MESSAGE or CHAT_COMMAND sent while the flag is HIDDEN, flagging each attempt.
checks.detects: Hidden-chat clients that keep sending chat, a common bypass primitive for chat moderation and reporting systems.
checks.variations: BetterAnticheat HiddenChatCheck implements the same rule with a one-message grace period instead of cancellation.

checks.name: CrashE view distance (Grim)
checks.purpose: Enforce the minimum view distance the client may advertise.
checks.how_it_works: On CLIENT_SETTINGS, wraps the packet and if the view distance is below 2, flags the value and rewrites it to 2 before the server processes the packet.
checks.detects: Clients advertising a zero or negative view distance, which destabilizes chunk sending and can be used as a crash or lag primitive.
checks.variations: BetterAnticheat SmallRenderCheck fails on the same condition but does not rewrite the value.

checks.name: SkinBlinkerSprinting (Photon)
checks.purpose: Catch skin-part toggles that happen while the player is sprinting or sneaking.
checks.how_it_works: On CLIENT_SETTINGS, reads the skin-parts bitmask and compares it to the last saved mask. If the player is sprinting or sneaking and the mask changed, the module flags with a violation level of 50. An unmodified client can only change settings from the menu, where sprint and sneak are impossible.
checks.detects: Skinblinker mods that flash skin parts during movement, which is how many 1.8-era skinblinker bypasses worked.
checks.variations: The sibling module SkinBlinkerUnusedBit flags the 0x80 bit in the same mask, which vanilla clients never set; LabyMod and similar clients use that bit for cosmetics.

checks.name: HiddenChatCheck (BetterAnticheat)
checks.purpose: Catch players who hide the chat but keep chatting.
checks.how_it_works: Tracks chatVisibility from CLIENT_SETTINGS (FULL and SYSTEM set canChat true, HIDDEN sets it false). When a CHAT_MESSAGE arrives while hidden, the check fails, with a one-message grace period because the settings packet can lag behind the chat packet.
checks.detects: Clients that hide the chat box while still sending messages, an evasion pattern for chat-based detection.
checks.variations: Grim ChatD is the same rule with hard cancellation instead of a grace period.

checks.name: SmallRenderCheck (BetterAnticheat)
checks.how_it_works: On CLIENT_SETTINGS, fails when the view distance is below 2, the lowest value an unmodified modern client can select.
checks.detects: Clients advertising render distances below 2, which some modules set to reduce chunk load or destabilize server chunk sending.
checks.variations: Grim CrashE flags and rewrites the same value; the BetterAnticheat version only records a fail.
